caseName: Papadopoulos v. Oregon State Board of Higher Education
caseNameFull: Papadopoulos v. Oregon State Board of Higher Education

opinions.text:
Appeal from Ct. App. Ore. dismissed

for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
